disqualifier.note: BoolKeyDefaultFalse residue: pinciteInherited is the parse fact; from/fromId are optional provenance. Docs say from is set only when inherited is true, but constructors and tests emit inherited true with none. No exclusive write/read in-repo; true+none is legal so the flag does not duplicate payload presence.

Same inheritance flag + optional predecessor as IdCitation. Tests construct pinciteInherited true without from; readers do not match exclusive variants. Independently observed short-form parse fact, not a masked union.
Same BoolKeyDefaultFalse inheritance flag + optional predecessor index/id. true+none is a documented legal constructor shape; no exclusive-write or exclusive-read site in this checkout.

pinciteIsRange is a wrapped default-false parse marker; pinciteEndPage is an optional numeric locator. Tests set pinciteIsRange true without an end page. No runtime coherence check; range-ness and end page are independently observed eyecite facts.

inFootnote is Option<boolean> (S.Boolean.pipe(OptionFromOptionalKey)) populated only when detectFootnotes is on; footnoteNumber is an optional locator. Missing vs false vs true are detection states, not exclusive writes against the number. Independently observed footnote facts at the eyecite driver boundary.

Only one boolean (optional preamble). article/amendment are optional numeric locators, not sibling booleans. Mutual exclusivity is a parse comment over mixed field kinds; no in-repo exclusive-write of the bits. When in doubt, not 2^n boolean creep.

Four independent toolbar axes in one region: dirty projects changelog-vs-saved, inferredView is a view toggle atom, canUndo is changelog nonempty, canRedo is redo-stack nonempty. After save, dirty can be false while canUndo is true; undo-all after a save can be dirty+!canUndo. All 16 combos occur. ToolbarState already covers the in-flight open/save/preview bits.

inferredView is the shared inferred-triples toggle; canRunSparql is session-present AND query-nonempty. Independent enablement vs view-mode; both true, both false, and mixed pairs all render. Not a masked union.
